title: AgentSpec
description: What hire_agent receives. The Factory validates it against config/policy.json before spawning.

id.description: Stable handle, used for @mentions, e.g. ios-dev

department.description: e.g. IT, Cloud, Marketing, Video, Travel

parent.description: id of the agent this one reports to ('orchestrator' for managers)

skills.description: Skill names to load, e.g. ponytail, booqy-meta-ads

tools.description: Allowlist. Must be a subset of the department's scope in policy.
